newsitem.title: EU: EP Agriculture Committee agenda - June 30-July 1.
newsitem.headline: EP Agriculture Committee agenda - June 30-July 1.

text.p: Committee on Agriculture and Rural Development [[ Monday 30 June 1997 ]]
2. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 20/21 May 1997 (PE222.485 ) - 26/27 May 1997 (PE222.486 )
===] In the presence of the Commission
3. Exchange of views with Mr Jozias VAN AARTSEN, Netherlands Minister for Agriculture, Nature Management and Fisheries, President-in-Office of the Council (to be confirmed)
4. The impact of biotechnology in agriculture (T04587) INI0443 INI0443 + AGRI Fond R KEPPELHOFF-WIECHERT (PPE) - Exchange of views in the presence of experts
5. Common organization of the market in hops (T05434) CNS97066 COM(97)0098 C4-0184/97 + AGRI Fond R MAYER Xaver. (PPE) (PE222.480 ) - Adoption of draft report
6. Marketing and labelling of beef (repealing Regulation 2067/92/EEC) (T05464) CNS97058 COM(97)0070 C4-0193/97 + AGRI Fond R HARDSTAFF Veronica M (PSE) (PE222.484 ) - Adoption of draft report

7. Commission report on the review of Directive 90/220/EEC (T05127) COS0508 COM(96)0630 C4-0008/97 + AGRI Avis A GORLACH Willi. (PSE) (PE221.790 ) F ENVI Fond R BOWE David R. (PSE) (PE222.540 ) - Adoption of draft opinion
8. Seed marketing (beets, fodder, cereals, seed potatoes, etc.) (T03214) CNS0808 COM(93)0598 C3-0002/94 + AGRI Fond R GRAEFE ZU B. (V ) (PE213.276/DEF) - Adoption of compromise amendments

9. Labelling, presentation and advertising of foodstuffs (ingredients of alcoholic beverages)(Am. Dir. 79/112/EEC) (T05402) COD97027 COM(97)0020 C4-0059/97 + AGRI Avis A KLA3 Christa B. (PPE) F ENVI Fond R SCHNELLHARDT Horst. (PPE) - Exchange of views

10. Improvement of the Community production of apples, pears, peaches and nectarines (T05404) CNS97031 COM(97)0035 C4-0135/97 + AGRI Fond R REHDER Klaus. (PSE) (PE221.788 ) - Consideration of draft report
12. Appointment of rapporteurs and draftsmen - decisions on procedure (possibly)
14. Date of next meeting in BRUSSELS (PE/II/OJ/97-14 )
14.2 NB: a coordinators' meeting will take place during the meeting (possibly) - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
